VaultConfig.title: Vault Configuration
VaultConfig.description: User specific security configuration for the vault.

hashedAnswers.description: SHA-256 hashes of the 10 security answers.

salt.description: Unique salt used for key derivation.

failedAttempts.description: Number of consecutive failed login attempts.

isCorrupted.description: Whether the vault is in a corrupted state due to limit exceeded.

VaultItem.title: Vault Item
VaultItem.description: An encrypted record of a card or account.

name.description: Encrypted or unencrypted label for quick filtering (depending on security needs). Prefer encrypted if full zero-knowledge.

AuditLog.title: Audit Log
AuditLog.description: An immutable record of an action performed within the vault.

actorId.description: UID of the user who performed the action.

actorEmail.description: Email of the user who performed the action.

vaults/{vaultId}/vault/config.description: Security setup for the user's vault.

vaults/{vaultId}/items/{itemId}.description: Individual encrypted items in the vault.

vaults/{vaultId}/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable history of actions for the vault.

system/config.description: Global application properties like rates and quotas.

vault_registry/{userId}.description: Index of all registered user vaults for administrative visibility.

payment_transactions/{txId}.description: Record of payment operations under Gateway simulation.
